name: Autotask PSA
description: Autotask PSA by Datto (Kaseya): query companies, contacts, tickets and notes, time entries, projects and tasks, resources, contracts and configuration items; create and update tickets, add notes and log time. Autotask REST API.
instructions:
## Autotask PSA
This connector uses the Autotask REST API (`/ATServicesRest/V1.0`) of Autotask PSA by Datto (Kaseya): companies, contacts, tickets, notes, time entries, projects, tasks, resources, contracts and configuration items.

## Setup
1. In Autotask create an API-only resource (Admin, Resources/Users, New API User) with the **API User (API-only)** security level. On its Security tab, under **API Tracking Identifier**, pick your integration vendor or let Autotask generate a custom (internal integration) identifier. The username (an email such as `abc123@example.com`), the generated secret and the tracking identifier are the three credentials.
2. `AUTOTASK_USERNAME` = the API user's username, `AUTOTASK_SECRET` = its secret, `AUTOTASK_INTEGRATION_CODE` = the API tracking identifier.
3. `AUTOTASK_ZONE_HOST`: every Autotask database lives in one zone with its own host. Open `https://webservices.autotask.net/atservicesrest/v1.0/zoneInformation?user=<API username>` in a browser; the `url` field shows the host, for example `webservices5.autotask.net`. Enter only the host.

The three values travel as the `ApiIntegrationCode`, `UserName` and `Secret` headers. A wrong zone answers 500 or 401 even with correct credentials.

## Querying
Read tools are `POST /<Entity>/query` searches (marked read-only). `filter` is an array of conditions, AND-combined: `{"op": "eq", "field": "status", "value": 1}`. Operators: eq, noteq, gt, gte, lt, lte, beginsWith, endsWith, contains, exist, notExist, in, notIn; nest with `{"op": "or", "items": [...]}`; user-defined fields need `"udf": true`. A query must have at least one condition; the default `{"op": "gte", "field": "id", "value": 0}` matches everything. Field names are camelCase as in the answers (`companyID`, `assignedResourceID`, `dateWorked`).

## Picklists
Status, priority, queue, issue type, note type and similar fields are numeric ids that differ per database. Call `autotask_get_entity_fields` (for example entity `Tickets`) to read the allowed values and labels before filtering or writing them. Ticket status 5 is Complete in a default setup.

## Paging and limits
A query returns at most 500 records (`max_records`). To read more, sort by id: repeat the query with an extra condition `{"op": "gt", "field": "id", "value": <last id>}` until fewer records come back. `pageDetails` also carries `nextPageUrl`. Use `include_fields` to keep answers small. Autotask allows 10,000 requests per hour per database and slows responses above half of that; use `autotask_count_tickets` for counts instead of reading every ticket.

## Start here
`autotask_query_companies` to find a company id, then `autotask_query_tickets` with `companyID`, then `autotask_get_ticket` and `autotask_query_ticket_notes`. For time reports, `autotask_query_resources` gives the resource id for `autotask_query_time_entries`.

## Writes
Creating and updating tickets, adding ticket notes and logging time change data and can trigger customer notifications through workflow rules. Nothing is deleted by this connector.
prerequisites: An Autotask **API user** (a resource with the API User security level) and its API tracking identifier. Only an Autotask administrator can create one.

AUTOTASK_ZONE_HOST.label: Zone host
AUTOTASK_ZONE_HOST.help: Open https://webservices.autotask.net/atservicesrest/v1.0/zoneInformation?user=<API username> in a browser and copy the host from the url field, without https:// and without a path.
AUTOTASK_ZONE_HOST.patternMessage: Only the host, for example webservices5.autotask.net.

AUTOTASK_USERNAME.label: API username
AUTOTASK_USERNAME.help: The Username of the API-only resource (Admin → Resources/Users), an email-like value.

AUTOTASK_SECRET.label: API secret
AUTOTASK_SECRET.help: The secret generated for the API user on the same page (Generate Secret). It is shown in full only when generated.

AUTOTASK_INTEGRATION_CODE.label: API tracking identifier
AUTOTASK_INTEGRATION_CODE.help: Security tab of the API-only resource, section API Tracking Identifier: the vendor identifier or the generated custom (internal integration) identifier.

verifyHints.401: Autotask refused the credentials. Check the username, secret and API tracking identifier of the API user, and that the zone host belongs to this database.
verifyHints.500: Autotask could not resolve the request in this zone. Look up the zone host again with zoneInformation and check the username.
verifyHints.404: No Autotask REST API at this host. Enter only the zone host, for example webservices5.autotask.net.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Autotask allows 10,000 requests per hour per database. Wait and try again.

tools.name: autotask_query_companies
tools.description: Query companies (customers, prospects, vendors) with an Autotask filter: name, type, phone, address, owner resource and active flag. Up to 500 per call. Read-only POST search.

filter.description: Autotask filter array, combined with AND. Each item is {"op": "<operator>", "field": "<field name>", "value": <value>}. Operators: eq, noteq, gt, gte, lt, lte, beginsWith, endsWith, contains, exist, notExist, in, notIn (value is an array for in/notIn). Group with {"op": "or", "items": [...]}; user-defined fields need "udf": true. Default matches every record: [{"op": "gte", "field": "id", "value": 0}]. Example: [{"op": "contains", "field": "companyName", "value": "Acme"}]

include_fields.description: Return only these fields, for example ["id", "title", "status"]. Smaller answers; default all fields.

tools.name: autotask_get_company
tools.description: Get one company by id with all standard fields and user-defined fields. Use it after autotask_query_companies or when another record carries a companyID.

id.description: Company id (companyID on tickets, contacts and projects).

tools.name: autotask_get_entity_fields
tools.description: Describe the fields of an entity: name, data type, whether it is required or read-only, and for picklists the allowed values with their numeric ids and labels. Call it before filtering or writing status, priority, queue or type fields.

entity.description: Entity name in the REST URL, for example Tickets, Companies, Contacts, TimeEntries, Projects, Tasks, Resources, Contracts, ConfigurationItems, TicketNotes.

tools.name: autotask_query
tools.description: Query any Autotask entity that has no dedicated tool (for example Roles, BillingCodes, ServiceCalls, Opportunities, Invoices, Quotes) with an Autotask filter. Read-only POST search.

entity.description: Entity name in the REST URL, for example Roles, BillingCodes, ServiceCalls, Opportunities, Invoices.

filter.description: Autotask filter array, combined with AND. Each item is {"op": "<operator>", "field": "<field name>", "value": <value>}. Operators: eq, noteq, gt, gte, lt, lte, beginsWith, endsWith, contains, exist, notExist, in, notIn (value is an array for in/notIn). Group with {"op": "or", "items": [...]}; user-defined fields need "udf": true. Default matches every record: [{"op": "gte", "field": "id", "value": 0}]. tools.name: autotask_create_ticket
tools.description: Create a service desk ticket for a company. Status, priority, queue and type values are numeric picklist ids from autotask_get_entity_fields on Tickets. Returns the new ticket id as itemId.

status.description: Status picklist id, for example 1 = New in a default setup.

queue_id.description: Queue picklist id. Autotask needs a queue or an assigned resource.

due_date_time.description: Due date and time in UTC, ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-08T16:00:00Z.

contact_id.description: contactID of the person who reported it.

assigned_resource_role_id.description: Role of the assigned resource (from autotask_query with entity Roles).

ticket_type.description: Ticket type picklist id (service request, incident, problem, change request, alert).

source.description: Source picklist id (phone, email, web portal, ...).

configuration_item_id.description: Configuration item the ticket is about.

contract_id.description: Contract to bill the work against.

tools.name: autotask_update_ticket
tools.description: Change fields of an existing ticket: status, priority, queue, assigned resource, due date, title or description. Only the fields passed are changed (PATCH). Returns the ticket id.

status.description: New status picklist id, for example 5 = Complete in a default setup.

due_date_time.description: New due date and time in UTC, ISO 8601.

resolution.description: Resolution text, usually set when completing the ticket.

tools.name: autotask_create_ticket_note
tools.description: Add a note to a ticket. publish 1 makes it visible to all Autotask users and the customer portal, 2 to internal users only. Customers may be notified by workflow rules.

note_type.description: Note type picklist id from autotask_get_entity_fields on TicketNotes, for example 1 = Task Detail.

publish.description: Visibility picklist id: 1 = All Autotask Users, 2 = Internal Only (default setup).

tools.name: autotask_create_time_entry
tools.description: Log time worked on a ticket or task for a resource: date, start and end time or hours, role, summary and internal notes. Returns the new time entry id.

ticket_id.description: Ticket worked on (give ticket_id or task_id).

role_id.description: Role the work is billed as.

hours_worked.description: Hours worked, when start and end are not given.

summary_notes.description: Summary shown on the ticket and invoice.

internal_notes.description: Internal notes, not shown to the customer.

is_non_billable.description: true to mark the time as non-billable.
